$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.JobRecord plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.
description: Read-only lifecycle record returned by `vigil assess kali job list/status`. Do not construct manually — the orchestrator writes these rows.

id.title: Id
id.description: Database primary key for this job row.

parent_command_run_id.title: Parent Command Run Id
parent_command_run_id.description: ID of the assessment_command_runs row that spawned this dtach job.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. 'queued': row written, dtach not yet started. 'running': worker live. Terminal: 'completed' (exit 0), 'failed' (exit !=0), 'killed' (SIGKILL), 'lost' (socket gone), 'stop_failed' (kill attempt failed).

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the dtach worker first attached. Null until 'running'.

ended_at.title: Ended At
ended_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the worker exited or was killed. Null until terminal.

exit_code.title: Exit Code
exit_code.description: Process exit code. 0 = success; non-zero = failure. Null until terminal status.

dtach_socket_path.title: Dtach Socket Path
dtach_socket_path.description: Filesystem path to the dtach control socket. Pass to `vigil assess kali job tail` to reattach to a running job.

stdout_path.title: Stdout Path
stdout_path.description: Absolute path to the stdout spill file under ${ENGAGEMENT_DIR}/scans/kali/.

stderr_path.title: Stderr Path
stderr_path.description: Absolute path to the stderr spill file under ${ENGAGEMENT_DIR}/scans/kali/.

audit_metadata.title: Audit Metadata
audit_metadata.description: Structured fields captured at dispatch: technique, intent, probe_kind, destructive (bool), phase, agent_name.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the job row was inserted.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last status update.

title: Assessment Job Record
